column2: scripts/reaper_parity/probe-midi-quantize-selected-overlap-chain.lua; selected note index 2; script performs no explicit MIDI_Sort

The selected note start moves 180→240 and its selected note-off event moves 300→360. REAPER's MIDI_GetNote readback keeps that selected note at 240–300 and reports the following unselected same-key note as 330–360; the remaining reported notes are unchanged. This extends the two-note selected-scope case where the moved note-off had no intervening same-key neighbor.

Before quantizing, REAPER's note-table readback reports note 4 ending at 480 although the raw stream contains its note-off at 520; the raw event rows are retained to make this pre-existing overlap/readback behavior explicit.
